contacts.name: Yosemite park information
contacts.reaches: The recorded road and weather line, plus general NPS questions. NPS says its web road table only lists planned or long-term closures, so the recording is the place for short-notice changes: press 1, then 1, for roads. Listen before entering in winter and again as conditions change. Press 3, then 5, to reach a person.
hours: Closed for lunch; recordings run 24 hours
location: Mail: Visitor Information Office, PO Box 577, Yosemite, CA 95389
In person: Welcome Center, Yosemite Village

texting.note: Texting is not mentioned by the listed sources for this number.

contacts.name: Wilderness & Half Dome questions
contacts.reaches: A seasonal NPS line for backpacking, wilderness permits and Half Dome questions. Permits themselves are collected in person at the Wilderness Center.
hours: In service approximately May–September; the Valley Wilderness Center closes Oct 18, 2026
location: Yosemite Valley Wilderness Center, Yosemite Village

texting.note: Texting is not mentioned by the listed sources for this number.

contacts.name: Yosemite Medical Clinic
contacts.reaches: Walk-in urgent care and appointment-based primary care. It is not an emergency room; in an emergency call or text 911 rather than this number.
hours: Primary care · Mon–Thu, 9 am–12 pm by appointment; enrollment of new primary-care patients paused (NPS, checked Oct 23, 2026)
Urgent-care availability may vary with staffing; call ahead. Limited insurance accepted; NPS advises out-of-state patients to plan to pay out of pocket.
location: Between Yosemite Village and The Ahwahnee

texting.note: The clinic page mentions texting only for 911: “If you have a medical emergency, text or call 911.” Nothing suggests the clinic line itself takes texts.

contacts.name: Roadside assistance · Yosemite Garage
contacts.reaches: NPS says the garage takes no walk-ins; call 209-372-1060 to arrange repairs or propane. Roadside help and towing run around the clock and the air hose out front works 24 hours. Confirm before driving over. No gasoline is sold in the Valley.
hours: Garage · daily, 8 am–12 pm and 1–5 pm

contacts.name: Yosemite Chapel
contacts.reaches: The historic community chapel: Sunday services, weddings and twice-weekly AA meetings.
location: Southside Drive at Sentinel Meadow, Yosemite Valley

texting.note: Texting is not mentioned by the listed sources for this number.

contacts.name: Yosemite switchboard
contacts.reaches: The central Yosemite Hospitality (Aramark) number, confirmed against federal records. Visitors suggest asking the operator for lodging including Housekeeping Camp, dining, activities or the Yosemite Garage; which transfers work, and when the switchboard is staffed, has not been checked. New lodging bookings go to 888-413-8869 and roadside help to 209-372-1060.

texting.note: Texting is not mentioned by the listed sources for this number.

contacts.name: Housekeeping Camp · reservations & guest help
contacts.reaches: Numbered lodging units are booked through Yosemite Hospitality, not Recreation.gov. For an existing stay, visitors suggest asking the switchboard for Housekeeping registration; neither listed line is a confirmed direct front-desk number. The camp has a store, a laundry open to the public and guest-only showers; check-in is 4 pm and check-out 11 am.
hours: Reservations · daily, 8 am–5:30 pm Arizona time
On-site front desk · staffed 24 hours during the operating season
2026 season · April 3–October 12; confirm operation before travel
location: Housekeeping registration / store, Southside Drive, Yosemite Valley

texting.note: Texting is not mentioned by the listed sources for this number.

contacts.name: Lodging reservations & customer service
contacts.reaches: Yosemite Hospitality's central reservations line: one number for The Ahwahnee, Yosemite Valley Lodge, Curry Village and Housekeeping Camp.

contacts.name: Curry Village front desk
contacts.reaches: The on-site desk for registered Curry Village guests: check-in questions, late arrivals and same-day problems. New bookings go through the central line.
hours: Lodging closure · Nov 29–Dec 10, 2026 (operator, checked Oct 23); confirm affected guest services before travel

contacts.name: Campground reservations · Recreation.gov
contacts.reaches: The national Recreation.gov line for Upper, Lower and North Pines and Camp 4. The Valley campgrounds have no local booking phone and walk-up space is rare.
hours: Booking is fastest online at Recreation.gov

Camp 4 and Wawona Loop A require reservations through the night of Nov 28, 2026; first-come from Nov 29. Wawona Loops B and C close Oct 26; Hodgdon Meadow becomes first-come after Oct 26 (NPS, checked Oct 23).
location: National call center — no local office

contacts.name: The Ahwahnee Dining Room reservations
contacts.reaches: The reservations line for the hotel's fine-dining room. Guide 51.8 strongly recommends dinner reservations by this number or OpenTable and requires appropriate dress at dinner. The operator's page, checked October 5, 2026, adds that a hotel booking does not guarantee a table and encourages OpenTable.

Sunday brunch · 7 am–3 pm (to 2 pm from Oct 25)
location: The Ahwahnee, 1 Ahwahnee Drive, Yosemite Valley

contacts.name: Yosemite Mountaineering School
contacts.reaches: Lessons and guided climbs must be reserved. Backpacking and camping gear rentals are first-come with no reservations, so bring your own when you can. Call for current services and availability.

contacts.name: ADA cycles, scooters & wheelchair rentals
contacts.reaches: Adaptive bikes must be reserved in advance; call the Lodge stand to book an ADA scooter. Wheelchair rentals are listed without a stated reservation policy. Standard bikes are first-come, so confirm what is available.
hours: Guide 51.8 · daily, 9 am–5 pm from Sep 28 through the October 25 season end

Hours conflict (checked Oct 25, 2026): Guide 51.8 lists 9 am–5 pm from Sep 28; the operator's undated table lists 8 am–7 pm. Both end the 2026 season October 25, conditions permitting. Confirm today's hours with the rental stand.
